---
name: Maintenance Report
about: Track maintenance, refactoring, or housekeeping work for this project
title: 'Maintenance: <short description of the task>'
labels: maintenance
assignees: ''
---

## Maintenance Task

A clear description of the maintenance task (refactor, dependency upgrade, cleanup, infrastructure change, etc.).

## Motivation

Why does this work matter? Examples: technical debt, security, performance, developer experience.

## Scope

What is included in this task and what is explicitly out of scope?

## Risk Assessment

- Are there any breaking changes?
- Could this introduce regressions?
- Does it require downtime or a migration?

## Verification Plan

How will we verify the change works correctly?
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Integration tests
- [ ] Manual verification steps
- [ ] Monitoring / alerts review

## Schedule

Proposed timeframe (e.g. next sprint, before release v1.0.0, opportunistic).

## Additional Context

Links to related issues, PRs, or documentation.
